schemes.title: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
schemes.department: Department of Science & Technology, Ministry of Science & Technology
schemes.description: Prestigious national scholarship of ₹80,000 per year (₹60,000 scholarship + ₹20,000 mentorship) to meritorious students within the top 1% of Class 12 pursuing B.Sc. or Integrated M.Sc. in natural sciences.
